notes: Highly selective. The Spartan Youth page lists a 3.0 GPA minimum and says it is a free residential program.
name: Teacher Education Academy and Kinesiology Academy
what_you_do: Spend a week living on the MSU campus. Take a college prep class, a writing class, and an intro class in urban teaching or body movement science. Learn about scholarships and the FAFSA.
who_can_apply: Current 11th graders from partner school districts. These are in Lansing, Detroit, Flint, Grand Rapids, Saginaw, Muskegon and nearby towns. You are interested in teaching or in body movement science.
pay_detail: Listed as free on the Spartan Youth Programs page.
duration: One week. 2026 dates were July 5 to 10.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed Friday, April 24, 2026 at 5 PM. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online. Write an essay of 500 words. Send your January transcript. Give your own email and a different parent email. Name a counselor or school leader who will back you. Do an online interview. Contact Kelley Johnson at johnsok1@msu.edu.
